steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.state.visitor={stage:'due'}; g.visitor.startFall(); for(let i=0;i<125;i++) g.visitor.update(0.1); for(let i=0;i<400 && g.visitor.zib.sculpt;i++) g.visitor.zib.sculptStep(50); g.visitor.hello(); g.screens.close(); g.visitor.invite(); g.tesla.finishSculpt(); g.state.gear.climbing=true; __rhf.session.save(); return 'saved: '+localStorage.length+' keys'})()

steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const v=g.state.visitor; return 'after continue: stage '+(v&&v.stage)+' follow '+(v&&v.follow)+' site '+!!g.visitor.site+' zib '+!!g.visitor.zib+' crash place '+!!g.world.place('crash')+' science '+Object.keys(g.state.science||{}).length})()

steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const r=[]; for(const [name,tab] of [['journal','science'],['journal','goals'],['telescope','tonight'],['telescope','scope'],['shop','gear'],['map',null]]){ try{ g.screens.open(name, tab?{tab}:{}); r.push(name+'/'+tab+' ok'); g.screens.close(); }catch(e){ r.push(name+'/'+tab+' ERR '+e.message); } } return r.join(', ')})()
steps.label: the journal, telescope, shop and map screens open without an error

steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const p=g.world.place('tesla'); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,p.face); for(let i=0;i<30;i++){ g.tesla.update(0.05); g.visitor.update(0.05);} __rhf.session.readTesla(); g.screens.close(); __rhf.session.runCoil(); for(let i=0;i<20;i++) g.tesla.update(0.05); __rhf.session.readHydro(); g.screens.close(); return 'tesla flags '+!!g.state.flags.tesla+','+!!g.state.flags.coil+','+!!g.state.flags.hydro+' science '+Object.keys(g.state.science).join(',')})()
